note: Reference material. Interpretive statements are traditional rule-based guidance, not scientific claims.

topics.title: God Details
topics.description: Principal deities with their mantra, vahana, graha association and traditional remedial use.

items.name: Ganesha
items.attributes: Remover of obstacles; lord of beginnings, wisdom and intellect.
items.mantra: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः — Om Gaṃ Gaṇapataye Namaḥ
items.note: Invoked first in every ritual. In Jyotish practice Ganesha worship is prescribed where Ketu or the lagna lord is afflicted, or before beginning any new undertaking.

items.name: Shiva
items.attributes: The auspicious one; dissolution, detachment, yoga and grace.
items.mantra: ॐ नमः शिवाय — Om Namaḥ Śivāya
items.offering: Water, bilva leaves, white flowers, milk
items.note: Rudrabhisheka is the standard classical remedy for a severely afflicted Moon, for Sade Sati, and for Mrityu-related doshas.

items.name: Vishnu
items.attributes: Preserver and sustainer; dharma, order and protection.
items.mantra: ॐ नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय — Om Namo Bhagavate Vāsudevāya
items.note: Prescribed where Jupiter is weak, combust or in dusthana, and for general dharma-related afflictions.

items.name: Durga
items.attributes: Protective mother; destroyer of evil, courage and invincibility.
items.mantra: ॐ दुं दुर्गायै नमः — Om Duṃ Durgāyai Namaḥ
items.note: Durga Saptashati recitation is the classical remedy for severe Mars or Rahu affliction and for protection-related prashna.

items.name: Lakshmi
items.attributes: Wealth, prosperity, beauty, abundance and fortune.
items.mantra: ॐ श्रीं महालक्ष्म्यै नमः — Om Śrīṃ Mahālakṣmyai Namaḥ
items.note: Standard prescription for an afflicted 2nd or 11th lord and for Venus-related dhana yoga strengthening.

items.name: Hanuman
items.mantra: ॐ हं हनुमते नमः — Om Haṃ Hanumate Namaḥ
items.offering: Sindoor, chameli oil, boondi laddu, betel leaf
items.note: The single most prescribed remedy in Indian practice for Sade Sati, Shani Dhaiya, Mangal Dosha and Kuja-related obstruction.

items.name: Saraswati
items.attributes: Knowledge, speech, music, learning and the arts.
items.mantra: ॐ ऐं सरस्वत्यै नमः — Om Aiṃ Sarasvatyai Namaḥ
items.note: Prescribed for afflicted Mercury, weak 4th/5th house, and for students during adverse Budha antardasha.

items.name: Krishna
items.attributes: Divine love, strategy, dharma in action, joy.
items.mantra: ॐ क्लीं कृष्णाय नमः — Om Klīṃ Kṛṣṇāya Namaḥ
items.note: Recommended for relationship-house afflictions and for emotional Moon-related difficulty.

items.name: Rama
items.attributes: Ideal conduct, righteousness, duty and steadiness.
items.mantra: ॐ रां रामाय नमः — Om Rāṃ Rāmāya Namaḥ
items.note: Prescribed for a weak or afflicted Sun, father-related karma and authority/status blockage.

items.name: Kali
items.attributes: Time, destruction of ego, fierce protection and liberation.
items.mantra: ॐ क्रीं कालिकायै नमः — Om Krīṃ Kālikāyai Namaḥ
items.note: Tantric prescription for severe Rahu-Ketu axis affliction; traditionally undertaken only under guidance.

items.name: Surya
items.attributes: Vitality, soul, authority, health and the father principle.
items.mantra: ॐ घृणिः सूर्याय नमः — Om Ghṛṇiḥ Sūryāya Namaḥ
items.offering: Arghya (water at sunrise), red flowers, wheat
items.note: Surya Arghya at sunrise is the primary graha-shanti for a debilitated, combust or 6/8/12-placed Sun.

items.name: Shani
items.attributes: Discipline, karma, delay, endurance and justice.
items.mantra: ॐ शं शनैश्चराय नमः — Om Śaṃ Śanaiścarāya Namaḥ
items.offering: Black til, mustard oil, iron, black cloth
items.note: Worshipped throughout Sade Sati and Ashtama Shani; classical texts emphasise service and restraint over ritual alone.

topics.title: Lord Details
topics.description: Graha lordship, dignity and the deity mapped to each planet in remedial practice.

items.name: Budha (Mercury)
items.karaka: Intellect, speech, trade, nerves, maternal uncle
items.nature: Neutral — takes the colour of its associates

items.name: Brihaspati (Jupiter)
items.karaka: Wisdom, children, wealth, dharma, husband for women

items.name: Shukra (Venus)
items.karaka: Marriage, beauty, vehicles, art, wife for men

items.name: Rahu (North Node)
items.karaka: Obsession, foreign matters, sudden rise, illusion

items.name: Ketu (South Node)
items.karaka: Detachment, moksha, past karma, sudden loss

topics.title: Mantra Details
topics.description: Classical mantras with text, transliteration, japa count, graha and source reference.

items.name: Gayatri Mantra
items.text: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः । तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं । भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि । धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
items.transliteration: Om bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ, tat savitur vareṇyaṃ, bhargo devasya dhīmahi, dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt
items.purpose: Illumination of the intellect, clarity, removal of mental dullness.

items.name: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
items.text: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात् ॥
items.transliteration: Om tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam, urvārukamiva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt
items.purpose: Healing, longevity, protection during illness and Mṛtyu-related periods.

items.name: Hanuman Beeja Mantra
items.text: ॐ हं हनुमते रुद्रात्मकाय हुं फट्
items.transliteration: Om haṃ hanumate rudrātmakāya huṃ phaṭ
items.purpose: Courage, protection from obstruction, relief during Sade Sati and Mangal Dosha.

items.name: Navagraha Mantra
items.text: ॐ ब्रह्मा मुरारिस्त्रिपुरान्तकारी भानुः शशी भूमिसुतो बुधश्च । गुरुश्च शुक्रः शनिराहुकेतवः कुर्वन्तु सर्वे मम सुप्रभातम् ॥
items.transliteration: Om brahmā murāris tripurāntakārī bhānuḥ śaśī bhūmisuto budhaśca, guruśca śukraḥ śanirāhuketavaḥ kurvantu sarve mama suprabhātam
items.purpose: General propitiation of all nine planets; recited at the start of the day.

items.name: Shri Suktam
items.text: ॐ हिरण्यवर्णां हरिणीं सुवर्णरजतस्रजाम् । चन्द्रां हिरण्मयीं लक्ष्मीं जातवेदो म आवह ॥ (opening ṛk)
items.transliteration: Om hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ suvarṇarajatasrajām, candrāṃ hiraṇmayīṃ lakṣmīṃ jātavedo ma āvaha
items.purpose: Attraction of wealth, prosperity and household stability.

items.name: Ganesha Mula Mantra
items.purpose: Removal of obstacles before any new undertaking.

items.name: Saraswati Mantra
items.purpose: Study, memory, speech, examinations and creative work.

items.name: Surya Mantra
items.text: ॐ ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रौं सः सूर्याय नमः
items.transliteration: Om hrāṃ hrīṃ hrauṃ saḥ sūryāya namaḥ
items.purpose: Strengthens a weak, combust or debilitated Sun; vitality and authority.
items.bestTime: Sunday at sunrise while offering arghya

items.name: Chandra Mantra
items.text: ॐ श्रां श्रीं श्रौं सः चन्द्राय नमः
items.transliteration: Om śrāṃ śrīṃ śrauṃ saḥ candrāya namaḥ
items.purpose: Emotional steadiness, sleep, mother-related karma.

items.name: Shani Mantra
items.text: ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः
items.transliteration: Om prāṃ prīṃ prauṃ saḥ śanaiścarāya namaḥ
items.purpose: Relief during Sade Sati, Ashtama Shani and Saturn dasha difficulty.

items.name: Guru (Brihaspati) Mantra
items.text: ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरवे नमः
items.transliteration: Om grāṃ grīṃ grauṃ saḥ gurave namaḥ
items.purpose: Wisdom, marriage for women, children, and 9th-house fortune.

items.name: Rahu Mantra
items.text: ॐ भ्रां भ्रीं भ्रौं सः राहवे नमः
items.transliteration: Om bhrāṃ bhrīṃ bhrauṃ saḥ rāhave namaḥ
items.purpose: Confusion, sudden reversals, Kaal Sarpa-related difficulty.

topics.title: Tantra Details
topics.description: Tantric traditions, ritual classes and methods, referenced as scholarship.

items.name: Shakta Tantra
items.deity: Devi in her ten Mahavidya forms
items.summary: The Goddess-centred stream. Worship proceeds through nyasa, mantra japa and yantra, with the Dasha Mahavidya as its principal deities.
items.caution: Classical texts require initiation (diksha) from a qualified teacher before formal practice.

items.name: Shaiva / Agamic Tantra
items.summary: Temple ritual, consecration and daily worship in South Indian and Kashmiri traditions derive their procedure from the Shaiva Agamas.
items.caution: Agamic procedure is prescriptive; local temple practice varies by sampradaya.

items.name: Shatkarma
items.summary: The classical sixfold classification of tantric rites: Shanti (pacification), Vashikarana (attraction), Stambhana (arresting), Vidveshana, Uchchatana and Marana.
items.caution: Only the Shanti and Paushtika (nourishing) classes are prescribed in ordinary remedial practice. HoraSaar references the remaining categories as scholarship, not instruction.

items.name: Nyasa
items.summary: Ritual placement of mantra syllables on the body and in space before japa, establishing the practitioner as the seat of the deity.
items.caution: Performed as a preliminary; the specific nyasa depends on the mantra received at initiation.

items.name: Purascharana
items.summary: The formal completion of a mantra: a fixed count of japa (commonly 100,000 per syllable) followed by homa, tarpana, marjana and brahmana-bhojana at one tenth each.
items.caution: Counts and procedure differ by text and lineage.

items.name: Dasha Mahavidya
items.deity: Kali, Tara, Tripurasundari, Bhuvaneshvari, Bhairavi, Chhinnamasta, Dhumavati, Baglamukhi, Matangi, Kamala
items.summary: The ten wisdom goddesses, each with a distinct mantra, yantra and sphere of effect. Several are mapped to grahas in remedial practice.
items.caution: Several of the ten are traditionally approached only after initiation.

topics.title: Yantra Details
topics.description: Yantras with geometry, metal, placement direction and governing mantra.

items.name: Shri Yantra
items.geometry: Nine interlocking triangles forming 43 smaller triangles around a central bindu.
items.purpose: Abundance, prosperity and consciousness; regarded as the foremost yantra.
items.placement: North-east of the home or altar, facing east
items.mantra: ॐ श्रीं ह्रीं क्लीं ऐं सौः

items.name: Shri Ganesha Yantra
items.geometry: Central bindu with hexagon and eight-petalled lotus.
items.purpose: Removal of obstruction at the start of a project or business.
items.mantra: ॐ गं गणपतये नमः

items.name: Navagraha Yantra
items.geometry: Nine numbered cells, one per graha, in a 3×3 arrangement.
items.purpose: General planetary propitiation where several grahas are afflicted at once.
items.placement: Altar, facing east; worshipped on the weekday of each graha
items.mantra: Navagraha Stotra

items.name: Kuber Yantra
items.geometry: Magic square whose rows and columns total 72.
items.purpose: Savings, treasury and retained wealth rather than income flow.
items.mantra: ॐ यक्षाय कुबेराय वैश्रवणाय धनधान्याधिपतये नमः

items.name: Mahamrityunjaya Yantra
items.geometry: Central triangle with beeja syllables inside an eight-petalled lotus.
items.purpose: Health, longevity and protection during illness.
items.mantra: Om Tryambakaṃ Yajāmahe…

items.name: Shani Yantra
items.geometry: Magic square whose rows and columns total 45.
items.purpose: Worn or installed through Sade Sati and Shani dasha.
items.mantra: ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः

items.name: Baglamukhi Yantra
items.geometry: Central bindu with triangle, hexagon and eight petals.
items.purpose: Litigation, disputes and stalling of opposition; traditionally undertaken under guidance.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्लीं बगलामुख्यै नमः

topics.title: Gemstone Details
topics.description: The nine classical ratna with metal, finger, weight, day, mantra and cautions.

items.name: Ruby
items.mantra: Om Ghṛṇiḥ Sūryāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Confidence, authority, recognition, paternal relations, eyesight and heart vitality.
items.caution: Not advised when the Sun rules a maraka or badhaka house, or for Taurus and Libra lagna without careful review.

items.name: Pearl
items.mantra: Om Śrāṃ Śrīṃ Śrauṃ Saḥ Candrāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Emotional calm, sleep, maternal bonds, fluid balance and mental peace.
items.caution: Generally avoided with Blue Sapphire and Hessonite; review for Capricorn and Aquarius lagna.

items.name: Red Coral
items.mantra: Om Krāṃ Krīṃ Krauṃ Saḥ Bhaumāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Courage, drive, blood and muscular vitality, property matters, Mangal Dosha support.
items.caution: Can raise heat and irritability; reviewed carefully for Gemini, Virgo, Taurus and Libra lagna.

items.name: Emerald
items.mantra: Om Brāṃ Brīṃ Brauṃ Saḥ Budhāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Intellect, speech, study, trade, nervous system and communication clarity.
items.caution: Reviewed for Aries and Scorpio lagna where Mercury rules difficult houses.

items.name: Yellow Sapphire
items.mantra: Om Grāṃ Grīṃ Grauṃ Saḥ Gurave Namaḥ
items.benefits: Wisdom, teaching, wealth, children, marriage prospects for women, liver health.
items.caution: Reviewed for Taurus and Libra lagna; generally not combined with Diamond.

items.name: Diamond
items.mantra: Om Drāṃ Drīṃ Drauṃ Saḥ Śukrāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Relationships, artistic refinement, luxury, reproductive health and charm.
items.caution: Usually not combined with Ruby or Yellow Sapphire; reviewed for Cancer and Leo lagna.

items.name: Blue Sapphire
items.mantra: Om Prāṃ Prīṃ Prauṃ Saḥ Śanaiścarāya Namaḥ
items.benefits: Discipline, focus, professional endurance and rapid results when suitable.
items.caution: The most reactive stone in the classical list. Always trialled before wearing; traditionally never worn on a casual recommendation.

items.name: Hessonite
items.mantra: Om Bhrāṃ Bhrīṃ Bhrauṃ Saḥ Rāhave Namaḥ
items.benefits: Clarity during confusion, protection in Rahu dasha and Kaal Sarpa patterns.
items.caution: Trialled first; reviewed alongside Pearl, which is generally not combined with it.

items.name: Cat's Eye
items.mantra: Om Srāṃ Srīṃ Srauṃ Saḥ Ketave Namaḥ
items.benefits: Protection from sudden loss, spiritual insight, relief in Ketu dasha.
items.caution: Effects reported as fast and sharp; trial period is standard practice.

topics.title: Rudraksha Details
topics.description: Mukhi-wise rudraksha with ruling graha, deity, chakra and wearing mantra.

items.name: 1 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Leadership, clarity of purpose, detachment from ego; traditionally associated with headaches and heart vitality.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं नमः

items.name: 2 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Harmony in relationships and partnerships; emotional steadiness.
items.mantra: ॐ नमः

items.name: 3 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Release of guilt and past burden; digestive fire and self-confidence.
items.mantra: ॐ क्लीं नमः

items.name: 4 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Learning, speech, memory and creative expression.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं नमः

items.name: 5 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: The most common bead; general wellbeing, calm and study. Worn as a 108-bead mala.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं नमः

items.name: 6 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Willpower, focus, grounding and relational balance.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं हुं नमः

items.name: 7 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Relief from Saturn-related hardship; prosperity and endurance.
items.mantra: ॐ हुं नमः

items.name: 8 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Removal of obstacles; support during Rahu dasha and Kaal Sarpa patterns.
items.mantra: ॐ हुं नमः

items.name: 9 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Courage, protection, release of fear; support during Ketu periods.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं हुं नमः

items.name: 11 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Strength, protection and steadiness of mind.
items.mantra: ॐ ह्रीं हुं नमः

items.name: 14 Mukhi Rudraksha
items.benefits: Intuition, decisiveness; traditionally regarded as the most prized bead.
items.mantra: ॐ नमः शिवाय

topics.title: Chalisa Details
topics.description: Forty-verse devotional hymns with deity, purpose and recommended day.

items.name: Hanuman Chalisa
items.purpose: Protection, courage, relief from obstruction, Sade Sati and Mangal Dosha support.
items.opening: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज, निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।

items.name: Ganesh Chalisa
items.purpose: Removal of obstacles before a new venture, examination or journey.
items.opening: जय गणपति सदगुण सदन, कविवर बदन कृपाल ।

items.name: Durga Chalisa
items.purpose: Protection, courage, relief from fear and enemy-related difficulty.

items.name: Shiv Chalisa
items.purpose: Health, longevity, Moon affliction and Mrityu-related concern.
items.opening: जय गणेश गिरिजा सुवन, मंगल मूल सुजान ।

items.name: Shani Chalisa
items.purpose: Recited through Sade Sati, Ashtama Shani and Shani dasha.
items.opening: जय गणेश गिरिजा सुवन, मंगल करण कृपाल ।

items.name: Lakshmi Chalisa
items.purpose: Household prosperity, financial stability, 2nd and 11th house support.
items.opening: जय जय श्री महालक्ष्मी, करूं मातु तव ध्यान ।

items.name: Saraswati Chalisa
items.purpose: Study, memory, speech and examination preparation.
items.opening: जनक जननि पद्मरज, निज मस्तक पर धारि ।

topics.title: Aarti Details
topics.description: Aarti hymns with deity, timing, opening line and the items used.

items.name: Om Jai Jagdish Hare
items.purpose: Universal evening prayer for peace and prosperity.
items.opening: ॐ जय जगदीश हरे, स्वामी जय जगदीश हरे ।

items.name: Sukhkarta Dukhharta
items.timing: Morning and evening; daily in Ganesh Chaturthi
items.purpose: Removal of sorrow and obstacles.

items.name: Jai Ambe Gauri
items.purpose: Invocation of the protective mother.
items.opening: जय अम्बे गौरी, मैया जय श्यामा गौरी ।

items.name: Om Jai Shiv Omkara
items.purpose: Closing aarti after Rudrabhisheka.
items.opening: ॐ जय शिव ओंकारा, स्वामी जय शिव ओंकारा ।

items.name: Aarti Kunj Bihari Ki
items.purpose: Devotional joy and emotional steadiness.
items.opening: आरती कुंजबिहारी की, श्री गिरिधर कृष्ण मुरारी की ।

items.name: Aarti Shri Hanuman Ji Ki
items.purpose: Strength and protection; follows the Hanuman Chalisa.

items.name: Om Jai Lakshmi Mata
items.purpose: Prosperity and household abundance.
items.opening: ॐ जय लक्ष्मी माता, मैया जय लक्ष्मी माता ।

topics.title: Names Details
topics.description: Nakshatra-pada naming syllables used for the traditional birth name (namakarana).

topics.title: Festival Details
topics.description: Festivals with the tithi or sankranti rule that fixes the date, deity and rituals.

items.name: Makara Sankranti
items.significance: Start of Uttarayana; the Sun turns northward.

items.name: Vasant Panchami
items.significance: Start of spring; auspicious for beginning education.

items.name: Mahashivaratri
items.significance: The great night of Shiva; night-long vigil in four praharas.

items.name: Holi
items.significance: Victory of devotion over arrogance; arrival of spring.

items.name: Ugadi / Gudi Padwa
items.significance: Lunar new year in the Deccan and Maharashtra; Panchanga Shravanam.

items.name: Rama Navami
items.significance: Birth of Rama at midday in Punarvasu nakshatra.

items.name: Hanuman Jayanti
items.significance: Birth of Hanuman; observed on different dates regionally.

items.name: Akshaya Tritiya
items.significance: Regarded as an unfailing muhurta; whole day is auspicious.

items.name: Guru Purnima
items.significance: Honouring the teacher; start of Chaturmasya.

items.name: Nag Panchami
items.significance: Traditionally observed for Kaal Sarpa and Naga dosha relief.

items.name: Raksha Bandhan
items.significance: Sibling bond; tied during a Bhadra-free window.

items.name: Pitru Paksha
items.significance: Fortnight for ancestral offerings; linked to Pitru Dosha remediation.

items.name: Navaratri
items.significance: Nine nights of the Goddess; Sharada Navaratri.

items.name: Vijayadashami / Dussehra
items.significance: Regarded as a self-evident muhurta for beginnings.

items.name: Diwali
items.significance: Festival of lights; Lakshmi Puja in the Pradosha window.

items.name: Chhath
items.significance: Arghya to the setting and rising Sun over four days.
